question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution: The correct answer is **"eliminating". ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Eliminating" **means to completely remove or get rid of something. (किसी चीज़ को पूरी तरह से हटाना या छुटकारा पाना।) • In this context, it indicates that the swift healing and rebonding of the corneal tissue after laser eye surgery make stitches unnecessary, thus "eliminating" the need for stitches. • This is the appropriate choice. Therefore, the sentence should read: • "This corneal tissue is amazing because it heals and rebonds immediately, eliminating the need for stitches." • It signifies the fact that due to the rapid healing of the corneal tissue, there is no requirement for stitches post-surgery, hence it effectively "eliminates" the need for them. Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 4". ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • "Abolishing" - This term means to officially end a system, practice, or institution.(किसी प्रणाली, प्रथा या संस्था को आधिकारिक तौर पर समाप्त करना) • However, the concept of "abolishing stitches" seems unusual and does not fit correctly in the given context related to the healing of corneal tissue. • "Destroying" - This word refers to causing so much damage to something that it no longer exists or cannot be repaired. (किसी चीज़ को इतना अधिक नुकसान पहुँचाना) • However, the healing process of corneal tissue doesn't "destroy" the need for stitches but rather removes or makes it unnecessary. • Thus, this word is not an apt choice. • "Demonstrating" - This term means to clearly show the existence or truth of something by giving proof or evidence.(प्रमाण या प्रमाण देकर किसी बात का अस्तित्व या सत्यता स्पष्ट रूप से दर्शाना) • This doesn't fit the context as we're looking for a word that shows the removal or negation of need for stitches. 4c:Ta3f, The correct answer is **"small". **
